comment: Source read at commit 21bfcbf, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.0. The Max and Min knobs are configured with defaults of -5 and +5 (QuickMelody.cpp:29-30), so the default Max is below the default Min; the output is computed as (max - min) * phase + min at line 103, which simply runs the sweep downward. The Max and Min inputs replace their knobs rather than being added to them.
